title: DR reflection plan: ux layer (58 relationship changes)
rationale: Relationship schemas in the ux layer that the maintainer-note triage and the sorting-question reflection (cli/scripts/spec-enrich) want removed, renamed, reversed or retargeted. Each operation carries the claims and Clef's sorting answers as evidence and the plan's probability. Accepting an operation means DR applies it with apply-walk.ts; rejecting means the schema stays.

operations.rationale: Remove ux.uxlibrary.aggregates.ux.librarycomponent: ux.uxlibrary.provides.ux.librarycomponent already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.57; claims rel:ux.uxlibrary#1.

evidence.quote: ux.uxlibrary has both 'aggregates' and 'provides' relationships to ux.librarycomponent, which overlap because membership and export usually coincide; keep 'aggregates' only if it covers internal, unexported members, otherwise drop one. Proposed: Drop one of aggregates/provides for librarycomponent, keeping aggregates only if it is meant to cover internal unexported members.

Sorting answers (rel:ux.uxlibrary#1): best source of 'aggregates ux.librarycomponent': ux.uxlibrary (0.84), none (0.07), ux.componentreference (0.02); best destination of 'ux.uxlibrary aggregates': ux.librarycomponent (0.78), ux.librarysubview (0.09), none (0.08); best predicate: provides (0.57), aggregates (0.21), none (0.06). Outcome: alternative (predicate=provides).

operations.rationale: Remove ux.librarysubview.composes.ux.componentinstance: ux.librarysubview.aggregates.ux.componentinstance already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.55; claims node:ux.librarysubview#1, rel:ux.librarysubview#1.

evidence.quote: The relationships 'aggregates' and 'composes' from ux.librarysubview to ux.componentinstance express the same meaning and are redundant. Proposed: Keep only one of 'aggregates' or 'composes' between librarysubview and componentinstance.

The relationships ux.librarysubview aggregates ux.componentinstance and ux.librarysubview composes ux.componentinstance are contradictory; the ComponentInstance definition implies composition, so the aggregates relationship is redundant or wrong. Proposed: Remove the aggregates relationship from ux.librarysubview to ux.componentinstance and keep composes.
